AnalyticalPeriodConfig.description:
Time axis definition for analysis.

This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for time-related calculations.
All modules must use this instead of hardcoded 8760/365 or date(year, 1, 1).

The time axis is defined by:
- start_datetime: When the analysis period begins
- interval_minutes: Data resolution (15 or 60)
- n_points: Number of data points (determines period length)

The end_datetime is calculated as: start + (n_points - 1) * interval

Usage:
- ToU pricing: Use time_index derived from this for zone lookup
- Capacity fee: Use time_index for working day determination
- Daily metrics: Use groupby(date) on time_index, NOT hardcoded 365 days

clock_mode.description: Clock mode: CET_FIXED (ignore DST) or LOCAL_TZ (honor DST)
clock_mode.title: Clock Mode

n_points.description: Number of data points (determines period length)
n_points.title: N Points

timestamps.description: If provided, use these timestamps 1:1 instead of generating from start_datetime
timestamps.title: Timestamps

AnalyticalPeriodConfig.title: AnalyticalPeriodConfig

ArbitrageConfig.description:
Configuration for Time-of-Use (ToU) arbitrage dispatch.

Arbitrage exploits price differences between tariff zones:
- Charge from grid when price is low (below threshold)
- Discharge when price is high (above threshold)

IMPORTANT: For NPV calculations, capacity fee (opłata mocowa) is NOT
included in price thresholds. It's calculated post-dispatch using
the capacity_fee_pl module based on the actual import profile.

Integration with STACKED mode:
- Peak shaving has priority 1 (can use full SOC range)
- PV surplus charging has priority 2 (always before grid charging)
- Arbitrage grid-charge has priority 3 (only if spare charging capacity)
- Arbitrage discharge has priority 4 (when price high and SOC > floor)

allow_grid_charging.description: Allow charging battery from grid for arbitrage. If False, only PV surplus can charge battery.
allow_grid_charging.title: Allow Grid Charging

capacity_fee_pln_kwh.description: Capacity fee in steering prices [PLN/kWh]. Keep 0 for accurate NPV.
capacity_fee_pln_kwh.title: Capacity Fee Pln Kwh

charge_below_percentile.description: Charge from grid when price below this percentile [%]
charge_below_percentile.title: Charge Below Percentile

discharge_above_percentile.description: Discharge when price above this percentile [%]
discharge_above_percentile.title: Discharge Above Percentile

max_cycles_per_day.description: Maximum EFC cycles per day for arbitrage. None = no limit.
max_cycles_per_day.title: Max Cycles Per Day

max_grid_charge_kw.description: Maximum power for grid charging [kW]. None = use battery power.
max_grid_charge_kw.title: Max Grid Charge Kw

max_throughput_mwh_per_day.description: Maximum throughput per day [MWh]. None = no limit.
max_throughput_mwh_per_day.title: Max Throughput Mwh Per Day

ArbitrageConfig.title: ArbitrageConfig

Arbitrage strategy for price-driven dispatch.

ConstraintsConfig.description:
User-defined constraints for BESS sizing optimization (v0.8.0).

These are soft constraints that filter which variants are considered
"feasible" for recommendation. Unlike grid_constraints (physical limits),
these are economic/business constraints that affect variant selection.

Variants violating constraints are still returned but marked as not feasible.

max_capex_pln.description: Maximum allowed CAPEX [PLN]. Variants exceeding this are not feasible.
max_capex_pln.title: Max Capex Pln

max_payback_years.description: Maximum allowed payback period [years]. Variants exceeding this are not feasible.
max_payback_years.title: Max Payback Years

max_unserved_load_kwh.description: Maximum allowed unserved load [kWh]. If set, variants exceeding this are not feasible.
max_unserved_load_kwh.title: Max Unserved Load Kwh

min_net_savings_pln.description: Minimum required annual net savings [PLN]. Variants below this are not feasible.
min_net_savings_pln.title: Min Net Savings Pln

min_npv_pln.description: Minimum required NPV [PLN]. Variants below this are not feasible. Can be negative to allow limited losses.
min_npv_pln.title: Min Npv Pln

require_no_unserved_load.description: If True, variants with any unserved_load_kwh > 0 are not feasible.
require_no_unserved_load.title: Require No Unserved Load

ConstraintsConfig.title: ConstraintsConfig

DegradationBudget.description:
Degradation budget constraints for battery lifecycle management.

Supports both annual and daily limits to control battery wear.
Daily limits are enforced in real-time during dispatch.
Annual limits are checked post-dispatch for reporting.

max_cycles_per_day.description: Max EFC cycles per day. Enforced in real-time during dispatch.
max_cycles_per_day.title: Max Cycles Per Day

max_efc_per_year.description: Max equivalent full cycles per year
max_efc_per_year.title: Max Efc Per Year

max_throughput_mwh_per_day.description: Max throughput per day [MWh]. Enforced in real-time during dispatch.
max_throughput_mwh_per_day.title: Max Throughput Mwh Per Day

DegradationBudget.title: DegradationBudget

FinanceConfig.description:
Financial parameters for NPV/cashflow calculation.

This provides explicit control over financial assumptions that affect
NPV, payback, and IRR calculations. All parameters are optional with
sensible defaults.

Note: capex_override_pln enables deterministic tests and what-if scenarios
without changing battery sizing assumptions.

bess_degradation_pct_per_year.description: BESS capacity degradation [%/year]. Applied to savings as (1 - rate)^year. E.g., 2.0 = 2% annual degradation.
bess_degradation_pct_per_year.title: Bess Degradation Pct Per Year

capex_multiplier_sweep.description: CAPEX multipliers for sensitivity analysis (e.g., [0.8, 1.0, 1.2]). NPV calculated at each multiplier. Results in capex_sensitivity.
capex_multiplier_sweep.title: Capex Multiplier Sweep

capex_override_pln.description: Override CAPEX for deterministic tests and what-if scenarios. If None, CAPEX is calculated from battery sizing.
capex_override_pln.title: Capex Override Pln

discount_rate_sweep.description: List of discount rates (e.g., [0.05, 0.08, 0.10, 0.12]) for sensitivity analysis. If provided, finance_summary will include discount_rate_sensitivity array.
discount_rate_sweep.title: Discount Rate Sweep

energy_price_multiplier_sweep.description: Energy price multipliers for sensitivity analysis (e.g., [0.8, 1.0, 1.2]). NPV calculated at each multiplier. Results in energy_price_sensitivity.
energy_price_multiplier_sweep.title: Energy Price Multiplier Sweep

horizon_years.description: Analysis horizon in years for NPV/cashflow calculation
horizon_years.title: Horizon Years

include_cashflow_timeseries.description: If True, include year-by-year cashflow_timeseries in finance_summary.
include_cashflow_timeseries.title: Include Cashflow Timeseries

opex_escalation_rate.description: Annual escalation rate for OPEX (0.02 = 2% per year)
opex_escalation_rate.title: Opex Escalation Rate

opex_pln_per_year.description: Fixed annual OPEX in PLN (added to % based OPEX)
opex_pln_per_year.title: Opex Pln Per Year

pv_degradation_pct_per_year.description: PV output degradation [%/year]. Applied to savings as (1 - rate)^year. E.g., 0.5 = 0.5% annual degradation.
pv_degradation_pct_per_year.title: Pv Degradation Pct Per Year

replacement_capex_pln.description: Replacement cost in PLN. If None, uses original CAPEX.
replacement_capex_pln.title: Replacement Capex Pln

replacement_year.description: Year for battery replacement (e.g., 10). If None, no replacement event.
replacement_year.title: Replacement Year

savings_escalation_rate.description: Annual escalation rate for savings (0.02 = 2% per year)
savings_escalation_rate.title: Savings Escalation Rate

FinanceConfig.title: FinanceConfig

GridConstraints.description:
Grid connection constraints (v0.7.0).

Defines physical limits of the grid connection that apply to both
baseline and project scenarios. These are hard limits that cannot
be exceeded regardless of battery operation.

allow_export.description: Whether grid export is allowed. If False, all excess PV is curtailed or stored in battery. Equivalent to max_export_kw=0.
allow_export.title: Allow Export

max_export_kw.description: Maximum grid export power [kW]. If set, excess PV is curtailed. None = no limit (unconstrained export).
max_export_kw.title: Max Export Kw

max_import_kw.description: Maximum grid import power [kW]. If set, load exceeding this + PV + battery results in unserved load. None = no limit (unconstrained import).
max_import_kw.title: Max Import Kw

unserved_load_penalty_pln_kwh.description: Penalty cost per kWh of unserved load [PLN/kWh]. Used for economic impact calculation when import cap causes unserved load.
unserved_load_penalty_pln_kwh.title: Unserved Load Penalty Pln Kwh

GridConstraints.title: GridConstraints

OptimizationConfig.description:
Configuration for multi-objective optimization.

Allows users to specify:
- Primary objective to optimize
- Hard/soft constraints to satisfy
OptimizationConfig.title: OptimizationConfig

OptimizationObjective.description:
Optimization objectives for BESS sizing.

Determines which metric is maximized/minimized during grid search.
OptimizationObjective.title: OptimizationObjective

PriceConfig.description:
Energy price configuration.

Supports two pricing modes:
1. Flat pricing (legacy): Single import/export rate
2. ToU pricing (Opcja B): OSD tariff + OTHER fees + capacity fee separately

When tariff_id is set, ToU pricing is used with:
- OSD rates = energia czynna + dystrybucja (combined from preset)
- other_fees = OZE + kog + jakość + akcyza (added on top)
- capacity_fee = calculated separately via capacity_fee_pl module

capacity_fee_fixed_pln_mwh.description: Fixed capacity fee rate [PLN/MWh] - only for 'fixed' method
capacity_fee_fixed_pln_mwh.title: Capacity Fee Fixed Pln Mwh

capacity_fee_som_pln_kwh.description: SOM rate for dynamic capacity fee [PLN/kWh]
capacity_fee_som_pln_kwh.title: Capacity Fee Som Pln Kwh

demand_charge_pln_kw_month.description: Monthly demand charge [PLN/kW/month] based on peak import
demand_charge_pln_kw_month.title: Demand Charge Pln Kw Month

demand_charge_pln_kw_year.description: Annual demand charge [PLN/kW/year] based on peak import
demand_charge_pln_kw_year.title: Demand Charge Pln Kw Year

tariff_id.description: OSD tariff preset ID. If set, uses ToU pricing instead of flat.
tariff_id.title: Tariff Id

PriceConfig.title: PriceConfig

PriceTimeseriesPlnPerMwh.description:
Per-step price timeseries in PLN/MWh (v2.0.0 SSoT).

This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for what prices were used in calculations.
All values are arrays of length 'steps' (matching period_info.steps).

Used for:
- Debugging: verify which prices were applied at each timestep
- Transparency: user can see exact ToU zone mapping
- Reproducibility: export prices + use as override for deterministic replay
- Validation: sum(price * energy) should match MoneyLedger totals

export_price_pln_per_mwh.description: Grid export price at each timestep [PLN/MWh]. Length = steps.
export_price_pln_per_mwh.title: Export Price Pln Per Mwh

import_price_pln_per_mwh.description: Grid import price at each timestep [PLN/MWh]. Length = steps.
import_price_pln_per_mwh.title: Import Price Pln Per Mwh

other_fees_pln_per_mwh.description: Other fees (OZE, kogeneracja, etc.) at each timestep [PLN/MWh]. Length = steps.
other_fees_pln_per_mwh.title: Other Fees Pln Per Mwh

timezone.description: Timezone used for ToU zone mapping
timezone.title: Timezone

unserved_penalty_pln_per_kwh.description: Unserved load penalty at each timestep [PLN/kWh]. Length = steps.
unserved_penalty_pln_per_kwh.title: Unserved Penalty Pln Per Kwh

PriceTimeseriesPlnPerMwh.title: PriceTimeseriesPlnPerMwh

SizingConstraint.title: SizingConstraint

allow_reserve_breach.description: Allow using reserve in emergency (with warning)
allow_reserve_breach.title: Allow Reserve Breach

reserve_fraction.description: SOC fraction reserved for peak shaving [0-1]
reserve_fraction.title: Reserve Fraction

analytical_period.description: Time axis configuration. If provided, is the single source of truth for time calculations.

annual_degradation_pct.description: Annual capacity degradation [%/year]. Used to calculate EOL capacity.
annual_degradation_pct.title: Annual Degradation Pct

arbitrage_config.description: ToU arbitrage configuration. If enabled, sizing includes arbitrage savings in NPV.

battery_trace_mode.description: Mode for battery trace output: 'none', 'preview' (first N rows), or 'full'. If set, overrides include_battery_trace flag.
battery_trace_mode.title: Battery Trace Mode

constraints_config.description: User-defined constraints for variant selection (max_capex, max_payback, min_npv). Variants violating constraints are marked as not feasible but still returned.

degradation_cost_pln_mwh.description: Degradation cost per MWh throughput [PLN/MWh]. Used for savings_breakdown.
degradation_cost_pln_mwh.title: Degradation Cost Pln Mwh

eol_capacity_factor.description: Target EOL capacity as fraction of BOL. 0.70 = size for 70% capacity at end of life.
eol_capacity_factor.title: Eol Capacity Factor

finance_config.description: Financial parameters for NPV/cashflow calculation. If not provided, uses default values from analysis_years/discount_rate.

grid_constraints.description: Grid connection constraints (max_export_kw, max_import_kw, allow_export). Applied to both baseline and project scenarios.

include_battery_trace.description: Include BatteryTraceTimeseries (per-step SOC and power flows) in response. Shows soc_kwh, charge_kw, discharge_kw at each timestep for dispatch debugging.
include_battery_trace.title: Include Battery Trace

include_economics_timeseries.description: Include per-timestep economics breakdown in response. False = only totals_pln (small). True = also timeseries_pln (large).
include_economics_timeseries.title: Include Economics Timeseries

include_energy_flows_timeseries.description: Include per-timestep energy flows in response. False = only totals_mwh (small). True = also timeseries_kwh (large).
include_energy_flows_timeseries.title: Include Energy Flows Timeseries

include_ledger_timeseries.description: Include LedgerTimeseries (per-step costs) in response. Shows import_cost/export_revenue/fees/penalty at each timestep for charts.
include_ledger_timeseries.title: Include Ledger Timeseries

include_money_ledger.description: Include MoneyLedger (baseline/project cost breakdown) in response. Shows all cost categories for transparency and reconciliation.
include_money_ledger.title: Include Money Ledger

include_price_timeseries.description: Include PriceTimeseries (per-step prices) in response. Shows import/export/fees prices at each timestep for debugging and replay.
include_price_timeseries.title: Include Price Timeseries

ledger_timeseries_mode.description: Mode for ledger timeseries output: 'none', 'preview', or 'full'. If set, overrides include_ledger_timeseries flag.
ledger_timeseries_mode.title: Ledger Timeseries Mode

power_steps.description: Number of power levels to test
power_steps.title: Power Steps

price_timeseries_mode.description: Mode for price timeseries output: 'none', 'preview', or 'full'. If set, overrides include_price_timeseries flag.
price_timeseries_mode.title: Price Timeseries Mode

price_timeseries_override.description: Explicit price timeseries to use instead of generated ToU prices. If provided, bypasses ToU mapping and uses these prices directly. Must match input data length (steps = len(load_kw)).

profile_unit.description: Unit of input profiles (must be kW_avg for sizing)

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for tariff price lookup. Required if arbitrage enabled.
start_date.title: Start Date

timeseries_preview_rows.description: Number of rows for 'preview' mode (default 48, min 12, max 240). Applies to all timeseries in preview mode.
timeseries_preview_rows.title: Timeseries Preview Rows

timezone.description: Timezone (e.g., 'Europe/Warsaw'). Used for period_info in response.
timezone.title: Timezone
